quote: On in stock NEW 2026 RAM 1500 REBELS ONLY! This includes 15% discount from the factory and an additional 5% discount from McPeeks off MSRP.

title: 'Closeout' specials language for new vehicles without visible sale dates or substantiation
quote: NEW VEHICLE CLOSEOUT SPECIALS
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The homepage promotes 'NEW VEHICLE CLOSEOUT SPECIALS' with no start/end dates or substantiation captured in the page text, and the featured specials include current-model-year 2026 vehicles. 'Closeout' language on current-model-year inventory implies an end-of-run liquidation that may not be substantiable. Verify which vehicles the closeout banner links to; restrict closeout/clearance wording to genuinely discontinued or prior-model-year units and add offer date ranges.

title: Perpetual 'Sale Price' labeling on all used inventory without reference price or sale dates
quote: USED 2016 TOYOTA COROLLA LE ... Sale Price: $11,995
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Every used vehicle in the captured listing (and the used BMW X3 and RAM 2500 VDPs) is labeled 'Sale Price' with a single price, no former/reference price, and no sale start or end dates. Under B&P §17501 a 'sale' price implies a reduction from a genuine recent prior price; a site-wide, undated 'Sale Price' label functions as perpetual sale pricing. The former price may exist behind the collapsed 'Show more information' toggles, so verify on the live pages. If no genuine prior price backs the label, rename the field to 'Price' or 'McPeek's Price', or add the prior price and dated sale period.

title: Page title claims 'Certified Pre Owned' on a VDP for a vehicle listed as Used, not certified
quote: Certified Pre Owned Chrysler Dodge Jeep RAM

If this vehicle is not certified under a Stellantis CPO program, a title tag representing it as certified pre-owned risks violating VC §11713.18 (advertising a vehicle as certified when it is not) and also misleads search results. Verify whether this is a template title applied to non-CPO used VDPs; if so, correct the title template so only actual CPO units carry certified language.

title: Stacked bonus-cash rebates reach Net Price with qualification terms disclosed only generically
quote: Retail Bonus Cash: − $1,000 West BC Regional Retail Bonus Cash: − $1,000 Bonus Cash: − $500 Net Price: $29,496
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — New-vehicle listings and VDPs stack a dealer discount plus two to three bonus-cash incentives (including a 'West BC Regional' program) to reach the advertised Net Price. The stacked programs appear to be broadly available retail/regional bonus cash rather than restrictive conditional rebates, and the site does carry disclaimers ('Customer may not qualify for ALL Rebates shown. Some rebates are stackable and others can and cannot be combined' and 'Factory rebates may not be available if you choose special APR financing or lease programs'), so this is a prominence concern: per-rebate qualification criteria and expiration dates are not shown next to the price stack (expirations live only in VDP dealer comments). Verify each stacked program's eligibility and place a short qualification note and expiration adjacent to the Net Price.

title: Homepage email-collection form lacks privacy policy link and notice at collection
quote: Enter your email
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The crawler found one homepage lead form (email field only) with no privacy policy link, no notice at collection, and no TCPA consent language near it. No pricing or benefit appears to be gated behind it (has_price_gating = false), so this is a notice-at-collection gap rather than an undisclosed financial incentive. The site's ComplyAuto privacy policy does include a California Notice at Collection, so verify on the live page whether a link or footer notice sits near this form (it may exist outside the captured form markup). If absent, add a 'Notice at Collection' / privacy policy link at or before the point of collection.

title: 'Get My E-Price' offers a better price in exchange for contact information without financial-incentive disclosure
quote: Get Your NO BS Price No Hidden Charges. Transparent. Honest Pricing Get My E-Price
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Used VDPs (BMW X3, RAM 2500) display a Sale Price openly but offer a better 'E-Price' / 'best lease payment' in exchange for submitting contact information ('By filling out this form with your information we will be able to provide you with our best lease payment available'). Because a price benefit is exchanged for personal information, CCPA/CPRA financial-incentive rules may require a notice of financial incentive. Since the standard price is not gated, this is a gray area. Verify whether the ComplyAuto privacy program includes a financial-incentive disclosure covering e-price/lead offers; if not, add one or link the notice near these forms.

title: Used vehicle pages do not reference the upcoming CA 3-day cancellation right (forward-looking)
quote: USED 2016 TOYOTA COROLLA LE ... Sale Price: $11,995 REQUEST INFO TRADE VALUE PRE-QUALIFY
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — No reference to the 3-day cancellation right for used vehicles $50,000 or less was found in the captured text of the used inventory pages, and importantly no contradictory 'all sales final' or waiver language was found either. The primary disclosure obligation is at point of sale, and SB 766 is not operative until 10/1/2026, so absence on the website today is a best-practice gap only. This finding is based on partial page text (first 3,000 characters), so verify FAQ/policy pages before reporting. Recommend adding a brief, accurate note about the 3-day cancellation right to used vehicle pages ahead of the October 1, 2026 operative date.
